According to one embodiment, a semiconductor integrated circuit includes an arithmetic processing circuit, a first clock gating circuit, a first power switch, a second clock gating circuit, a second power switch and a controller. The arithmetic processing circuit comprises a first processor core performing arithmetic processing and a common unit containing cache memory storing data and programs. At least one of the first processor core and the common unit is divided into a first circuit and a second circuit. The first clock gating circuit supplies or cuts off a clock signal to the first circuit. The first power switch supplies or cuts off a power supply voltage to the first circuit. The second clock gating circuit supplies or cuts off the clock signal to the second circuit. The second power switch supplies or cuts off the power supply voltage to the second circuit. The controller controls the clock gating circuits and the power switches.

Semiconductor integrated circuitRelated application

Subject application is enjoyed by the priority of application case based on Japanese patent application 2014-259426 (applying date: on December 22nd, 2014).Subject application is the full content comprising basis application by referring to the application of described basis.

Technical field

Embodiments of the present invention relate to a kind of semiconductor integrated circuit being capable of low power consumption control.

Background technology

As semiconductor integrated circuit (LSI (LargeScaleIntegration, large scale integrated circuit)) low power consumption (power saving) control the exemplary process of technology, having following method: circuit definitions operating condition and the holding state to control object, the holding state not carrying out about circuit processing cuts down power consumption.

The concrete methods of realizing that power consumption under holding state is cut down can be enumerated and cut down dynamic current by Clock gating or cut down leakage current by dump.Clock gating is owing to quickly reverting to regular event, therefore that the impact of process performance is few, but then, cuts down the deleterious of power consumption compared with dump.On the contrary, the effect that dump cuts down power consumption is big, but then, reverts to regular event and expends time in, therefore that the impact of software control or process performance is big.

Improve to take into account power reducing and process performance, it is necessary to being controlled for each application or the adjustment relevant with process performance, this will cause the increase of development cost.Such as need such as inferior operation: corresponding to the length of the stand-by time in application, and determine to open or be not turned on power-saving control, or to electricity saving method being only set to Clock gating or implementing the detailed survey one by one such as Clock gating and both dumps and carry out software installation.

Summary of the invention

Embodiments of the present invention provide a kind of can take into account the semiconductor integrated circuit that power reducing improves with process performance.

The semiconductor integrated circuit of embodiment has arithmetic processing circuit, the 1st clock gating circuit, the 1st on and off switch, the 2nd clock gating circuit, the 2nd on and off switch and controller.Arithmetic processing circuit possesses: the 1st processor cores, carries out calculation process；And common portion, comprise the cache memory of storage data and program.1st processor cores and common portion at least any one is divided into the 1st circuit and the 2nd circuit.1st clock gating circuit is to the 1st circuit supply or stops supply clock signal.1st on and off switch supplies or voltage of cutting off the electricity supply to the 1st circuit.2nd clock gating circuit is to the 2nd circuit supply or stops supplying described clock signal.2nd on and off switch is to the 2nd circuit supply or cuts off described supply voltage.Controller controls the 1st and the 2nd clock gating circuit and the 1st and the 2nd on and off switch.
